components.name: Floating navigation
components.description: Centered 70dvh expanded navigation; focused rail uses compact automatic height.
components.css: .nav-demo{font-family:'Manrope Variable',sans-serif;color:var(--text,#172b50);background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--glass-highlight,rgba(255,255,255,.44)),transparent 65%),var(--glass,rgba(244,250,255,.28));border:1px solid var(--glass-edge,rgba(255,255,255,.74));box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff70,var(--glass-depth,0 8px 24px #294e8914);backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(140%);width:196px;padding:26px 14px;height:70dvh;max-height:70dvh;align-self:center;border-radius:30px;display:grid;gap:6px}.nav-demo button{font:700 13px Manrope,sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#425b7b);border:0;background:none;border-radius:14px;min-height:44px;padding:12px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .18s}.nav-demo button[aria-current]{color:var(--accent,#315dec);background:var(--selected,#e8efff);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff80,0 3px 9px #23477608}.nav-demo button:hover{background:var(--selected,#e8efff);transform:translateX(2px)}.nav-demo button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #739af5;outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.nav-demo button{transition:none;transform:none}}

components.name: Study modes
components.description: One measured glass indicator slides behind the selected button; static example shows its selected position. Production strip caps at 680px (740px on wide desktop), with at least 32px to filters; shared label is Exam Prep.
components.css: .mode-demo{position:relative;display:flex;height:44px;min-height:44px;align-items:center;gap:2px;padding:3px;border-radius:24px;background:var(--glass,rgba(244,250,255,.28));border:1px solid var(--glass-edge,#fff);backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(165%)}.mode-demo .selection{position:absolute;left:4px;top:3px;bottom:3px;width:64px;border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.72),rgba(233,243,255,.32));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.82);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px #fff,0 3px 10px #31538a12;transition:transform .34s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),width .34s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}.mode-demo button{position:relative;font:700 11px Manrope,sans-serif;height:36px;min-height:36px;padding:8px 9px;border:0;border-radius:20px;background:none;color:var(--muted,#425b7b);cursor:pointer}.mode-demo button[aria-pressed=true]{color:var(--accent,#315dec)}.mode-demo button:hover{color:var(--accent,#315dec);background:#ffffff1f}.mode-demo button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #739af5;outline-offset:3px}:host-context([data-theme=dark]) .selection{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(160,197,255,.22),rgba(144,181,242,.08));border-color:rgba(189,216,255,.32);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px #ffffff45,0 4px 12px #040c2526}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.mode-demo .selection{transition:none}}

components.name: Glass composer
components.description: Anchored writing surface with labelled Expand/Shrink control; live React state toggles expanded height.
components.css: .glass-composer{padding:12px 15px 10px;border:1px solid #cbd8ef;border-radius:18px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--surface,#fff) 62%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(145%);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff70,0 8px 26px #2443740d}.glass-composer textarea{font:13px/1.6 Manrope,sans-serif;width:100%;height:33px;max-height:80px;resize:none;overflow:auto;border:0;outline:0;background:none;color:var(--text,#172b50)}.glass-composer textarea::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#425b7b)}.glass-composer:focus-within{border-color:var(--accent,#315dec);box-shadow:0 5px 25px #315dec12}.glass-composer:hover{border-color:var(--accent,#315dec)}.glass-composer button{font:12px Manrope,sans-serif;background:none;border:0;color:var(--muted,#425b7b);padding:6px;cursor:pointer}.glass-composer button:hover{background:var(--selected,#e8efff)}.glass-composer button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #739af5;outline-offset:3px}.glass-composer textarea{transition:height .24s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.glass-composer.is-expanded textarea{height:clamp(70px,16dvh,150px);min-height:70px;max-height:150px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.glass-composer textarea{transition:none}}

components.css: .upload-demo{font:12px/1.5 Manrope,sans-serif;max-width:1080px;padding:24px;border-radius:20px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--surface,#fff) 67%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);color:var(--text,#172b50)}.upload-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(220px,.85fr) minmax(0,1.5fr);gap:24px}.drop{min-height:248px;padding:25px 20px;border:1px dashed #96afe6;border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface-2,#edf3ff);color:var(--accent,#315dec);cursor:pointer}.drop:hover{background:var(--selected,#e8efff);border-color:var(--accent,#315dec)}.fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}.fields label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;font-weight:700}.fields input,.fields select,.upload-demo textarea{min-width:0;padding:9px 11px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dfe7f4);border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg,#f3f6fc);color:inherit;font:12px Manrope,sans-serif}.upload-demo details{margin-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#dfe7f4);padding-top:10px}.upload-demo summary{cursor:pointer}.upload-demo footer{margin-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#dfe7f4);padding-top:14px;color:var(--muted,#425b7b)}.upload-demo :focus-visible{outline:3px solid #739af5;outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:650px){.upload-demo{padding:16px}.upload-split{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px}.drop{min-height:86px;padding:12px}.fields{gap:12px}}

narrative.overview: Blue-hour study desk: floating translucent navigation centers vertically, expanded to 70dvh while focus retains a compact rail. The approved cropped branding asset sit separately on the gradient backdrop. Measured focus and combined theme/profile controls flank the centered full heading; no long topbar. Taller desktop starter tiles accompany the anchored expandable composer. A single measured glass indicator selects modes in both themes. Compact mobile and short-height layouts remain; offline truth stays visible in the composer and uploads remain in the library. The masthead controls sit close to the centered heading, modes and filters match in height, and transparent scrollbar tracks preserve the continuous canvas. Upload is a dedicated compact form with a Resources return control, split dropzone/metadata and optional description disclosure. Focus anchors above Explain; the theme/profile pill matches the document-type filter. The shorter study strip uses Exam Prep consistently. Profile stores only a local display name, with no login or backend account.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet surfaces with strong ink and fine borders
Friendly language with a direct focus mode

Viewport-anchored composer and independently scrolling conversation

rules.name: The Readable Blue Rule
rules.body: Keep running text on solid semantic surfaces; protect upload labels from bright gradient stops.

rules.name: The Quiet Desk Rule
rules.body: Use tone and borders for everyday cards, with stronger depth reserved for overlays and the paper illustration.

dos: Do use semantic colors in both themes.
Do preserve visible focus and readable answer width.
Do keep decorative personality removable in focus mode.
donts: Don't replace the blue family with unrelated decorative accents.
Don't use the gradient as a general reading surface.
Don't remove study features in focus mode.
Don't rely on motion or color alone for essential state.
